# Band: the baguette mark, a dark rail 0.5 m long laid across a gem (along x) with a gold tip at
# each end on the velvet. Origin at its bottom centre. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Rail --base-color 0.0667 0.0706 0.0824 --no-slot
material new Tip --base-color 0.9608 0.8471 0.5765 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Rail --size 1 --location 0 0 0.03
scale 0.52 0.085 0.05
apply --scale
material assign Rail
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cone --name TipE --vertices 4 --radius1 0.085 --radius2 0 --depth 0.09 --location 0.31 0 0.045
material assign Tip
add mesh cone --name TipW --vertices 4 --radius1 0.085 --radius2 0 --depth 0.09 --location -0.31 0 0.045
material assign Tip
select Rail TipE TipW
active Rail
join
rename Rail Band
shade flat
export band.glb
